title_en: Build Shape and an overriding Square
spec_html_en: The base class Shape (given below) has __init__(self, name) storing name and method describe() returning f"{name}: no area defined". Implement subclass Square(Shape) with __init__(self, side) calling super().__init__("square"), storing side, and overriding describe() to return f"square: area is {side * side}".
